report.md:
## This week
You posted 19 videos this week. That is way more than last week's 5. But views dropped a lot. Your videos this week usually got around 927 views each, down from about 3,511 views each last week. Your best video was the one that starts with "girls that want to learn how to get paid to just make get ready with me all day without having any followers." It pulled 4,031 views. Your weakest was the one that starts with "I told you three months get everything that you wanted? dream job, your dream man." It only got 305 views. Posting more did not mean better views this time.

## Is it how you film, or what you say?
Almost everything you post is you talking to the camera, 137 of your videos. Because of that, you have not really tested other ways of filming enough to know if they help or hurt. Talking to camera itself lands right at your normal views, so it is not helping or hurting on its own. What matters more is what you are talking about. Your come-up videos, about how you got started, get about two and a half times your normal views, and you have posted 29 of them, so that is a real pattern. You do not have a side by side test yet, where you filmed the same script two different ways, so you cannot be fully sure if it is the words or the filming style doing the work. Right now, topic looks like it matters more than format.

## What is working
Your come-up videos are your strongest topic. You have posted 29, and they pull about two and a half times your usual views. Four of your 10 biggest videos were come-up videos.
Your real money numbers videos do even better. Only 8 of them, but they get about three and a half times your normal views.
When you tell people to check your link in bio, views explode. 8 videos, about 14 times your normal views, and 3 of your top 10 biggest videos used this.

## Try this next week
Film another come-up video, about how you got started, and end it pointing people to your link in bio. Both are your strongest tools right now.
Take one real money numbers story and film it as voice over footage instead of talking to camera. That is your best shot at finally telling if format or topic is doing the work.
Let one of your strongest topics run past a minute. Your longer videos are doing really well and you are not making many of them.

best.md:
This one did badly. It landed at 1,731 views, well under your usual, and well under what your "come up" style videos usually pull in, which tend to do about twice your normal number.

Your opening line was "Day in the life of a 23 year old girl making six figures a month." That is a strong, clear hook. It should stop the scroll. But right after that it drops into "because if I can do it, you can do it too" and then jumps straight into random clips without answering the question your hook just raised. People click for the six figure part and you don't deliver on that promise early, so a lot of them probably bounced.

After the opening, the video turns into loose day to day clips, Netflix talk, coffee, feeling tired. None of it builds on the money hook. There is no thread pulling people forward, so interest likely faded fast instead of holding.

There was no call to action at all. With a come up story like this, you could have asked people to follow for more of your day to day, or comment what they want to see next.

Next time, open with the six figure hook, then actually show or hint at the money part early, like your work setup or a number on screen, before you cut to the lifestyle clips.

worst.md:
This video did badly. It only got 305 views, while your normal video gets way more, over 15 times more.

Your opening line was "I told you three months get everything that you wanted? dream job, your dream man." This hook style, a very specific situation, usually does great for you, over 3 times your normal views. But this time it did not land that way, so the idea was good but something in the delivery or topic did not pull people in this time.

After the opening, the video does keep building. It stays on one clear pain point, the gap between where you are and the life you want, and pushes into the solution of acting like your best self now. That structure usually works fine for you.

There was no call to action at all. You could have asked people to follow for more mindset talks like this, or to comment the one thing they want most in three months.

Next time, keep this same hook style since it is one of your strongest, but test it with a different topic or delivery, and add a clear ask early or mid video instead of skipping it.
